newsitem.title: USA: Renters achieved 1997 store increase goal.
newsitem.headline: Renters achieved 1997 store increase goal.

text.p: Renters Choice Inc said Monday it has already acheived its yearly goal of increasing its store base by 15 to 20 percent.
The company said it plans to continue this trend through the rest of 1997 by making additional acquisitions and opening new stores.
Renters Choice increased its store base by 40 stores during the second quarter of 1997, ending the quarter with 492 stores and 246 franchised stores operating under the ColorTyme trade name.
The company reported earnings per share of $0.25 compared with $0.17 for the same period a year ago.
The company said same store revenue during the second quarter improved by $4.1 million, representing an increase of 8.3 percent above the comparable quarter in 1996.
The company said its improvements are in line with its original expectations.
